sectionRef: Build script — fragile cross-package output flattening
description: tools/overview-mcp/package.json build script uses 'tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e \"...cpSync(\'dist/overview-mcp/src\', \'dist\', { recursive: true })\"'. The nested dist/overview-mcp/src/ directory only appears because the package imports ../../../scripts/lib/sync-lock.mjs and ../../../scripts/lib/resolve-config.mjs across the package boundary, which forces tsc to relocate rootDir to the repo root. There is no rootDir or compose path constraint that documents this. A future refactor that removes the cross-package imports (or adds an explicit rootDir) would silently change the build output layout and break the fix-up step. The plan did not call for this approach — it expected a plain tsc build.
suggestedFix: Either (a) set rootDir explicitly in tsconfig.json to the package src/ and use 'composite' / TS project references to consume scripts/lib types without re-emitting, or (b) wrap the cross-package imports through a generated .d.ts shim under tools/overview-mcp/src/ so tsc only emits src files. Document the build-output expectation in README.
